notes.text: Modern catalogue entry for drawing 2017,2018.2. The catalogue attributes the drawing to Mathew James Harrison, Lieutenant, and dates the drawing to 1868. The curator's comment quotes Van Tilburg (2006:30) describing a red-scoria pukao at Puna Pau with canoe petroglyphs. Although the page also contains a generic comment that a statue is in the British Museum, this does not identify the pukao depicted in this drawing as Hoa Hakananai'a or establish another object identity; no object link or object claim is made. No image is published; image-specific reuse rights for this drawing have not been reviewed.
